how: Games Workshop's Warhammer Store & Cafe in Akihabara has gaming tables and beginner painting and casual play events, and the Tokyo Tactical Gaming Group runs 40k tournaments.

Yokohama Country and Athletic Club has a bowls green that hosted a one-off lawn bowls trial event in 2022; the national championship has been held at Showa Kinen Park (Tachikawa); no regular public play was found.

No bridge or tower bungee site was found inside the metro area; the nearest operator sites are Ryujin Gorge in Ibaraki (about 2 to 2.5 hours) and Minakami/Sarugakyo in Gunma (about 3 hours by train), run by Bungy Japan.
Tokorozawa Aviation Memorial Park in Saitama offers a roughly monthly early-morning hot air balloon ride booked online, with limited places; it is a short park ride and 2021 dates are listed.
venue: Tokorozawa Aviation Memorial Park balloon ride

how: Learn Filmmaking in Tokyo and Tokyo Film Industry Meetup run filmmaker meetups and workshops in the city, and Tokyo Film Club screens and discusses films.
Tokyo Unfiltered runs weekly guided night photo walks of alleyways and rooftops, and dungeon-themed night walks; abandoned-site (haikyo) groups were not found on Meetup.
Tokyo River Friends holds monthly Edogawa and Arakawa river clean-ups and Green Bird holds monthly volunteer clean-ups in Shibuya; no shoreline-specific event appeared in the listing.
Pioneer Toastmasters holds regular Tokyo public-speaking meetings (Meetup); no dedicated competitive debate club was found.
ManKind Project Tokyo runs a weekly peer support group for men and the Yamitomo meetup gathers people who feel mentally exhausted, both listed on Meetup.
Venture Cafe Tokyo at CIC Tokyo holds a weekly Thursday Gathering with a mentoring and coaching session; LFDT Tokyo has run a mentorship pilot.
No true ski simulator was found, but Tokyo-area indoor real-snow slopes exist: Snova Shin-Yokohama (60 m slope with rails and half-pipe) and Sayama Ski Resort in Saitama (300 m indoor slope).
MAYA Erhu Classroom near Roppongi-itchome offers one-to-one erhu lessons by a Japanese teacher trained at a Chinese conservatory, with a trial lesson advertised (2020 listing).
Kathak is performed in Tokyo at recitals such as the Tokyo Gharana series in Aoyama, associated with Japanese kathak exponent Atsuko Maeda; regular public classes were not confirmed.

Sashiko (Japanese stitch embroidery) workshops are run in Suginami by host canoha in English and Japanese for beginners, producing a stitched dish towel; general embroidery courses were not confirmed.

Beginner latte art classes capped at four guests run at Aizen Cafe & Bar in Nakano in Japanese, English and Chinese; THE ROASTERY by NOZY COFFEE and Kagetsudo Kaminarimon (Asakusa) also run short workshops.
Funabashi Sanbanze Seaside Park in Chiba has a large Tokyo Bay tidal flat with crabs and waterfowl, a seasonal clam-digging programme, and museum workshops that take visitors out onto the flats.
Forest Adventure Yokohama's trek course (60 to 120 minutes) crosses tree-top suspension bridges and rope ladders in a family-friendly forest circuit.

Discover Tokyo Walks and Tokyo Expat Social Club run regular guided neighbourhood and shrine walks (e.g. Kiyosumi-Shirakawa to Tsukishima, Yasukuni rites) in English and Japanese, and the city's historic districts suit self-guided walks.
Yokohama Chinatown, Japan's largest Chinatown, has the Kanteibyo and Mazu temples, a Chinese school, museums, lion dances, festivals and Chinese cooking classes.
Yokohama Chinatown is listed as having Chinese cooking classes; a dim sum class specifically was not confirmed.

No kiteboarding school inside the metro area was found; the nearest Tokyo Bay school, Sky Angel on Futtsu Cape in Chiba, offers beginner kitesurf lessons (about 1 to 1.5 hours away by road), and Shonan schools exist on the Kanagawa coast.

Sailability Tokyo and Tokyo American Club run beginner sailing experiences in Hansa 303 boats at Toyosu (members' programme), with beginner courses and Japanese boat licence help; Yokohama Bayside Marina has run a sailing cruiser experience.
